anomalies.observed: The schematic shows both U1 (ATtiny13V-10S) and U3 (ATtiny45-20P) connected to the same six signal nets, including their reset pins. No population option or isolation between the two controllers is shown.
anomalies.expected: A controller circuit should use one MCU for these shared I/O nets, or explicitly make the alternatives mutually exclusive. If both are populated, their outputs can contend.
